title: Iringa: The Gateway to Ruaha
excerpt: Iringa is the gateway to Ruaha National Park. A town with history, a market and nearby archaeological sites.
body:
## The town

Iringa lies on a plateau with a pleasant climate.

## What to do

- The central market.
- Isimila, a site with Stone Age tools and eroded pillars.
- The history of Chief Mkwawa, who resisted German colonial forces.

## Ruaha

Iringa is the last town before [Ruaha](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/), a few hours' drive.

[Plan your southern trip](/travel-proposal/).
